--- main with error dialog
on run
    try
        main()
    on error errMsg number errNum
        if errNum is not -128 then
            display dialog "Error: " & errMsg & " (" & errNum & ")" buttons {"OK"} default button 1 with icon stop
        end if
    end try
end run

on main()
    return 1
end main
--- droplet
on open theItems
    repeat with anItem in theItems
        processItem(anItem)
    end repeat
end open

on run
    open (choose file with multiple selections allowed)
end run

on processItem(f)
    return f
end processItem
--- idle application
property interval : 60

on run
    return
end run

on idle
    try
        checkSomething()
    end try
    return interval
end idle

on quit
    set interval to 0
    continue quit
end quit

on checkSomething()
end checkSomething
--- retry loop
on t(n)
    set attempts to 0
    repeat
        set attempts to attempts + 1
        try
            return doWork()
        on error msg number num
            if attempts ≥ n then error msg number num
            delay 1
        end try
    end repeat
end t

on doWork()
    return 1
end doWork
--- wait until
on t(appName)
    set waited to 0
    repeat until application appName is running or waited > 10
        delay 0.5
        set waited to waited + 0.5
    end repeat
    return waited
end t
--- early returns
on t(x)
    if x is missing value then return
    if x is "" then return ""
    if class of x is not text then return x as text
    try
        return x as integer
    end try
    return x
end t
--- nested conditions with else if and returns
on classify(n)
    if n < 0 then
        return "negative"
    else if n = 0 then
        return "zero"
    else if n < 10 then
        if n mod 2 = 0 then
            return "small even"
        else
            return "small odd"
        end if
    else
        return "large"
    end if
end classify
--- accumulate with multiple lists
on t(l)
    set {evens, odds, total} to {{}, {}, 0}
    repeat with n in l
        set n to contents of n
        set total to total + n
        if n mod 2 = 0 then
            set end of evens to n
        else
            set end of odds to n
        end if
    end repeat
    return {evens, odds, total}
end t
--- log file writer
on writeLog(msg, p)
    try
        set f to open for access (POSIX file p) with write permission
        write (msg & linefeed) to f starting at eof as «class utf8»
        close access f
    on error
        try
            close access (POSIX file p)
        end try
    end try
end writeLog
--- read file lines
on readLines(p)
    set f to POSIX file p
    set txt to read f as «class utf8»
    return paragraphs of txt
end readLines
--- shell with error check
on sh(cmd)
    try
        return {true, do shell script cmd}
    on error msg number n
        return {false, msg, n}
    end try
end sh
--- defaults and environment
on t()
    set home to POSIX path of (path to home folder)
    set user to short user name of (system info)
    set host to do shell script "hostname"
    set ver to system version of (system info)
    set env to system attribute "PATH"
    return {home, user, host, ver, env}
end t
--- dialog loop with validation
on askNumber()
    repeat
        set answer to text returned of (display dialog "Number?" default answer "")
        try
            return answer as integer
        on error
            display alert "Not a number" message answer
        end try
    end repeat
end askNumber
--- choose with cancel check
on t(choices)
    set picked to choose from list choices with prompt "Pick" without multiple selections allowed
    if picked is false then return missing value
    return item 1 of picked
end t
--- timestamps
on stamp()
    set d to current date
    set y to year of d as text
    set m to text -2 thru -1 of ("0" & (month of d as integer))
    set dd to text -2 thru -1 of ("0" & day of d)
    return y & "-" & m & "-" & dd
end stamp
--- sort handler
on sortList(l)
    repeat with i from 1 to (count of l) - 1
        repeat with j from i + 1 to count of l
            if item j of l < item i of l then
                set tmp to item i of l
                set item i of l to item j of l
                set item j of l to tmp
            end if
        end repeat
    end repeat
    return l
end sortList
--- recursion with lists
on flatten(l)
    set out to {}
    repeat with x in l
        if class of x is list then
            set out to out & flatten(contents of x)
        else
            set end of out to contents of x
        end if
    end repeat
    return out
end flatten
--- handler with optional behavior by class
on describe(x)
    set c to class of x
    if c is integer or c is real then
        return "number " & x
    else if c is text then
        return "text " & x
    else if c is list then
        return "list of " & (count of x)
    else if c is record then
        return "record"
    else if c is boolean then
        if x then return "yes"
        return "no"
    end if
    return "other"
end describe
--- property persisted counter
property runCount : 0
property lastRun : missing value

set runCount to runCount + 1
set lastRun to current date
if runCount > 10 then set runCount to 0
return {runCount, lastRun}
--- script with config record
property config : {name:"tool", retries:3, paths:{"/tmp", "/var"}, verbose:false}

on t()
    if verbose of config then log name of config
    repeat with p in paths of config
        log p
    end repeat
    return retries of config
end t
--- timeout around app command
on t()
    try
        with timeout of 120 seconds
            tell application "Finder" to set n to count of items of desktop
        end timeout
    on error number -1712
        return -1
    end try
    return n
end t
--- conditional tell
on t(appName)
    if application appName is running then
        tell application appName to quit
        delay 1
    end if
    tell application appName
        activate
    end tell
end t
--- result chains
on t(x)
    x * 2
    result + 1
    set y to result
    count of {1, 2, 3}
    if result > 2 then set y to y + result
    return y
end t
--- exit repeat with flag
on t(l)
    set found to false
    repeat with x in l
        if contents of x is 0 then
            set found to true
            exit repeat
        end if
    end repeat
    if not found then return -1
    return 0
end t
--- nested try with rethrow and cleanup
on t(p)
    set f to missing value
    try
        set f to open for access p
        set d to read f
        close access f
        return d
    on error msg number n
        if f is not missing value then
            try
                close access f
            end try
        end if
        error msg number n
    end try
end t
--- one line forms
on t(x)
    if x > 0 then set x to x - 1
    if x = 0 then return "zero"
    tell me to set y to x
    if y < 0 then error "negative" number 1
    return y
end t
--- handler calling handler in tell
on t()
    tell application "Finder"
        set n to my countThem(get every item of desktop)
        my logIt(n)
    end tell
    return n
end t

on countThem(l)
    return count of l
end countThem

on logIt(x)
    log x
end logIt
